description: Utility functions for date and time formatting, comparison, and relative time calculations in a Todo application.

methods.name: isSameDay
methods.description: Checks if two dates are on the same calendar day.

methods.name: timeAgo
methods.description: Returns a human-readable relative time string like 'in 2 days'.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Formats a date into a human-readable string, considering today, yesterday, or upcoming days.

methods.name: calculateDateDifference
methods.description: Calculates the difference between a given date and the current date, returning a descriptive string.

methods.name: shortRelativeTime
methods.description: Provides a short relative time string (e.g., '5m', '3h', '2d', '1mo').
